package.name: gui
package.description: Tkinter control panel for starting/stopping the main_bot Gazebo sim and clearing leftover gz/ros processes, instead of juggling several terminals by hand. Ported as-is from superDog's gui package, with the movement joystick/trot/balance-chart panel (specific to superDog's walking gait controller) replaced by babyDog's actual Stand/Sit/Estop buttons.
